recognitionRules: Use a continuous conceptual line as a reading path across observations and questions.
Pair Gill Sans explanation with restrained Chalkboard annotations.
Keep the evidence register on its own structured page.
Use rust to mark moments worth investigating, not to label participant failure.

writingLinks.reason: Follows a reading path from observation to test while keeping uncertainty explicit.

quote: Follow the first move. Ask what made it make sense.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use FIRST LINE in Gill Sans with a single open stroke continuing beneath the name. The line must not become a closed loop or maze.
invariants: Use a continuous conceptual line as a reading path across observations and questions.
Pair Gill Sans explanation with restrained Chalkboard annotations.
Keep the evidence register on its own structured page.
adaptations: A short poster may show three stops along the line.
Detailed records remain in a linked ledger rather than crowding the path.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
